entries.reason: Same test (233): a RETURN that succeeds ends the task, so the arm where RESP is NORMAL is never executed.

`IF WS-CICS-RESP NOT = DFHRESP(NORMAL)` after `RETURN TRANSID('OCCA') COMMAREA(WS-COMM-AREA) LENGTH(248)` (224-228): RETURN never comes back on success, so the test runs only when RETURN itself fails, and IBM documents no RESP for it with a 248-byte COMMAREA and an installed TRANSID.
`IF SEND-DATAONLY` tests the 88 on the flag value '2' (line 49), set by no statement: only `SET SEND-ERASE` and `SET SEND-DATAONLY-ALARM` (165, 220, 316) write the flag.
The RESP test inside the `IF SEND-DATAONLY` block (695), which is never entered.
The RESP test inside the `IF SEND-DATAONLY` block (695), which is never entered.
`IF SEND-DATAONLY-ALARM` is reached only with the flag '3': '1' (SEND-ERASE) leaves SM010 after the first SEND MAP and '2' is never set (see 695), so the test is always true.

`IF WS-CICS-RESP NOT = DFHRESP(NORMAL)` after the SEND TEXT ERASE FREEKB that writes the termination message (857-863): IBM raises no condition for it on a terminal that just sent a map, and no fault can be injected on it.
